description: This file defines a PHP trait named RetryHelperTrait within the Aws\Retry namespace. It provides utility methods to assist with retry logic, including adding retry headers to requests, updating statistical data related to retries and HTTP transfers, and binding statistical metadata to response objects or exceptions.

methods.name: addRetryHeader
methods.description: Adds a custom retry header to the request indicating the number of retries and delay.

methods.name: updateStats
methods.description: Updates the total retry delay and attempts in the provided statistics array.

methods.name: updateHttpStats
methods.description: Records HTTP transfer info from either an AwsException or a ResultInterface into the stats array.

methods.name: bindStatsToReturn
methods.description: Associates the collected statistics with the return object, which could be a ResultInterface or AwsException.
